Key soundness without key stability is a correct-but-useless cache: absolute worktree/target/registry/sysroot/OUT_DIR/tmp paths contaminate compiler args, dep-info, diagnostics, .rmeta, debuginfo, generated code, and incremental state, so separate agent worktrees would key and build logically identical work differently. Cargo itself computes package roots, unit hashes, -C metadata, output filenames, and child argv BEFORE any rustc wrapper runs — therefore the Cargo PROCESS must run inside the canonical namespace for workspace authority (a wrapper cannot retroactively canonicalize path-sensitive values Cargo already generated).
DELIVERABLES: Linux canonical Cargo-driver mount namespace; nested per-action closed input view prototype; fixed visible path layout (/__rabs/workspace, /__rabs/repos/LOGICAL-ID, /__rabs/registry/CHECKSUM, /__rabs/git/CHECKSUM, /__rabs/toolchain, /__rabs/cargo-home, /__rabs/out/UNIT, /__rabs/build/UNIT/out, /__rabs/incremental/UNIT, /__rabs/tmp, /__rabs/home, /run/rabs-secrets/SLOT); hidden attempt-specific physical backing roots; mutation-safe coherent snapshot capture; virtual-to-real diagnostic + materialization translation; path-remap flags; path/Cargo-unit-identity leak scanner; mtime choreography tests; checksum-freshness opt-in experiment; cross-worktree/cross-worker equivalence harness; explicit macOS VM/chroot/host-audit authority matrix (APFS clones alone do NOT give concurrent processes one canonical visible path; FSEvents observes changes, not reads).
ACCEPTANCE: canonical Cargo child argv, -C metadata, output filenames, descriptors, and admitted outputs CONVERGE across worktrees; no action/attempt/snapshot IDs leak into visible paths; diagnostics map back correctly; no rebuild storms after hit-like materialization; Linux strict profile meets its declared isolation boundary; macOS unsupported properties yield reduced authority, never a false pass.
GATE: workspace-member shared caching cannot become authoritative before canonical Cargo planning + the platform-specific isolation gate pass. Constituents: Epic D P0 items.

title: RABS M2: Asupersync runtime island and process ownership
description:
MILESTONE M2 — introduce Asupersync as the lifecycle substrate while keeping SSH/rsync transport (migration steps 1-2; no flag-day rewrite). DELIVERABLES: pinned Asupersync revision + minimal rabs-profile feature set; rabs-asupersync adapter crate (the ONLY broad adapter between RABS domain types and Asupersync/ATP types — no durable or public RABS schema may contain a type from it); explicit edge/coordinator/worker region trees (deployable combined); managed process groups for current whole-command remote actions; subscriber-aware cancellation skeleton; CargoRootPermit obligation type; supervision tree; action/attempt crashpacks; deterministic lab scenarios for cancellation/cleanup/observable-commit fallback; compatibility-isolated existing transport.
ACCEPTANCE: behavior parity with current RCH whole-command execution; no orphan process, root-permit, or double-slot release under chaos tests; cancellation and daemon shutdown bounded on covered paths; existing SSH/rsync path remains available.
GATE: Asupersync lifecycle becomes authoritative BEFORE ATP transport does. Rationale: regions/obligations/four-valued outcomes give provable resource cleanup (I7) at far lower risk than a transport swap, and let RABS retire the ad hoc remote-PGID-file + SSH-kill logic once parity is proven.
Constituents: Epic G P0 items + Epic A pins (A003/A004).

title: RABS M3: durable object store, metadata abstraction, atomic publication core
description:
MILESTONE M3 — the durable trust substrate. DELIVERABLES: rabs-cas filesystem backend with streaming atomic put_if_absent; ATP object/manifest adapters; deterministic tiny-object packs + chunk manifests; metadata-store interface; reference SQLite-compatible backend (truth source for differential and crash-recovery testing); FrankenSQLite backend + conformance harness (preferred dogfood, NOT authoritative until it matches the reference under the complete transaction/WAL-recovery/concurrency/fault-injection/migration suite); staging, journals, pins, leases, quarantine scopes, delayed tombstones; coordinator authority/high-water/incarnation-fence tables; action generation/tombstone, immutable publication, mutable serving, evidence/trust schemas; coordinator-only publication transaction; atomic publication reachability pins; authority-scoped pin leases; revisioned serving validity; reachability GC skeleton; scrubber; corruption/refetch tests; object CLI/doctor surfaces.
ACCEPTANCE: crash during ANY publication phase never exposes a partial action result (I8); a worker cannot commit an action pointer (I10); deterministic failures use the same typed immutable publication path as successes; action-generation/serving-state/publication-pin/authority-fence crash+replay invariants pass BEFORE the metadata core is trusted; one bad object location refetches without invalidating a valid logical object (scoped quarantine, I15); startup reconciliation repairs/reports staging/database drift; active pins and open readers survive GC; storage/packing/dedup metrics available.
NOTES: large object bytes never enter the metadata DB; the DB never lives on NFS/shared mutable storage; loss of nonauthority location/index metadata degrades to misses, but loss/rollback of authority/publication/generation-fence/trust/subscriber-delivery metadata requires restore/reconciliation or an explicit new credential/operator-reset generation — never treated as an ordinary cold cache (risk R113).
Constituents: Epic H P0 items.

title: RABS M4: registry/git dependency action cache (first served class)
description:
MILESTONE M4 — first authoritative product: immutable registry/git dependency rustc actions ("dependencies first": immutable checksummed inputs + highest compiler-second concentration). First served class precisely: immutable registry dependency rustc actions + checksummed immutable source + conservative exact dependency artifacts + exact presented environment + canonical toolchain/output platform + admitted dependency isolation profile + NO incremental state + no unresolved positive/negative inputs + normal successful exit + local edge CAS materialization. Expansion order afterward: immutable git deps -> native subcompiles inside dependency build scripts -> exact link cache -> remote dependency execution -> eligible dependency build-script runs -> selected workspace crates (canonical Cargo + minimal enforced closure only).
DELIVERABLES: immutable dependency action-family + exact action key; checksummed registry/git source manifests; exact presented-environment + toolchain/output-platform contracts; conservative exact dependency-artifact inputs; local CAS lookup and materialization; canonical compiler event capture/replay; .rmeta-first materialization only when .rmeta is a declared output; exact-diagnostics/presentation-variant handling; deterministic-failure classification; shadow mode + sampled serving; rch why miss for dependency actions.
ACCEPTANCE: ZERO divergence in a large shadow corpus; near-perfect hits for repeated immutable deps under the same semantic contract; cache-miss overhead <1-2% for admitted non-tiny actions with an absolute p95 cap for tiny probes; rustc artifact-notification replay preserves Cargo pipelining; first-enable cold rebuild documented; no reduced rlib projection implicitly enabled.
ROLLOUT: observation -> shadow -> opt-in sampled serving -> default-on for selected immutable dependency classes -> broad serving after cross-worker evidence. Constituents: Epic K P0 items + Epic F keys.

title: RABS M5: native dependency subcompiles and exact link cache
description:
MILESTONE M5 — extend serving to native builds and links: CC/CXX/AR wrappers; header/input closure; native toolchain/platform keys; build-script parent-child provenance; exact link action key + artifact bundle; pluggable Wild/lld/system linker profile; native+link miss explanations. Native subcompile interception deliberately precedes the generalized build-script-run cache because it captures a large fraction of expensive dependency build time (e.g. -sys crates) with comparatively mature semantics.
ACCEPTANCE: high-value -sys/native dependencies demonstrate substantial reuse; no stale native output under header/config changes; exact link hits preserve output and diagnostics; NO bespoke linker code introduced (explicit cut — Wild is the preferred upstream bet, lld the fallback).
SUBTLETY: a bare -lfoo / framework / default CRT is never keyed only by its spelling — the closed linker view must record actually-selected files, startup objects, default linker scripts, plugins, response-file inclusions, and failed/alternative lookup candidates (risk R123). If the selected linker can read an uncontrolled system search path RABS cannot close and reproduce, that link action stays local/nonshareable.
Constituents: Epic L P0 items.

title: RABS M6: authoritative coordinator, fleet singleflight, resource scheduler
description:
MILESTONE M6 — the headline capability: cross-agent cross-host singleflight (I5). DELIVERABLES: rabs-coord single-active coordinator authority (durable term/incarnation state, lexicographic peer high-water marks, edge/worker incarnation fences, external-fencing contract); edge/coordinator session + combined deployment mode; fleet-wide DiscoveryActor + ActionActor registries; cross-edge subscriber interest + cancellation; coordinator-owned Cargo root permits; host/worker jobserver integration; worker pressure/eligibility snapshots; deterministic admission receipts; cache-locality + transfer break-even scoring; foreground/optional/cleanup priorities; action history model; fifteen-agent multi-host storm benchmark.
ACCEPTANCE: concurrent identical demand across edge hosts joins ONE primary attempt lineage (extra attempts only under explicit retry/recovery/hedge/verify policy); coordinator restart advances term + new incarnation, closes/supersedes prior-authority generations, rejects stale offers; disaster recovery is manual and proves the old authority fenced; one subscriber cancel harms nobody; last-subscriber cancel drains everything; every Cargo implicit token backed by a root permit; storm improves at least 2x at this stage (3x final target); no system-wide swap collapse.
DESIGN: single authority is NOT one thread/mutex — shard actor registries by ActionKey, bounded mailboxes, isolate authority/cancellation/lease queues from telemetry/bulk planning; only the narrow metadata transactions that create generations, mutate serving state, or commit publications serialize (risk R130). Fail-open is an availability mode, not a performance guarantee: coordinator loss may lose fleet singleflight/root-permit accounting; wrappers may use a pre-existing host-local limiter but never wait on stale distributed authority; telemetry labels this UncoordinatedLocalFallback and storm benchmarks include the degraded case (R87).
Constituents: Epic I P0 items + G017-G020.

title: RABS M7: ATP native control plane (shadow then authoritative)
description:
MILESTONE M7 — replace SSH control with RABS/1-over-ATP/0, shadow-first. DELIVERABLES: canonical ATP frame fix (deterministic extension-map ordering); explicit version negotiation; durable identities + coordinator authority + transport binding; bounded critical/control/event queues; independent per-domain sequences with causal references; heartbeat/capability/pressure streams; action submission/join/cancel/lease/reconciliation messages; transcript/stateful delivery intent/ack/uncertainty/completion + bounded edge-handoff/fencing messages; worker prepared-result offer + coordinator commit notification; state-changing 0-RTT disabled; native QUIC reactor hardening (remove fixed 1ms polling, reactor/timer wakeups, injected time, adaptive packet batching, soak); Tailscale path integration; shadow comparison against existing RCH control.
ACCEPTANCE: ZERO lifecycle disagreement in shadow runs; reconnect/reconciliation/event-replay suite passes; cancellation/authority/lease-renewal/reconciliation traffic stays responsive under bulk load (dedicated control connection OR proven QUIC-scheduler SLO — risk R68); prolonged soak passes; path fallback behavior explicit.
GATE: SSH remains authoritative fallback until native control passes ALL gates. Asupersync blockers to fix first (plan Part IX sec 44): canonical frame encoding; protocol version negotiation; durable remote identities (process-local numeric task IDs insufficient for reconciliation); bounded asynchronous send admission (per-peer byte/msg limits, priority lanes, reserve/commit, control-plane reserve); managed QUIC event loop; durable CAS backend adapter; regenerated live coverage ledgers (stale PLANNED rows unacceptable); nested-runtime/timer regression pins.
Constituents: Epic J control-plane items.

title: RABS M8: ATP object data plane
description:
MILESTONE M8 — replace rsync with ATP object transfer. DELIVERABLES: bounded missing-object negotiation (batched FindMissingObjects; Bloom/inventory hints are never correctness authority); deterministic pack/chunk/manifest and range/bitmap transfer (no per-chunk ACK flood — risk R54); flow-control credits + reserved control capacity; resumable sparse writes + journals; source snapshot/artifact/toolchain/incremental-object transfer; early-artifact priority path (.rmeta, dep-info, compiler errors first); worker/edge local inventory + coordinator-directed seeding; dual rsync-vs-ATP private materialization comparison.
ACCEPTANCE: exact logical tree/materialization equality; interrupted transfer resumes without duplicate publication; measured throughput and time-to-first-useful-artifact meet targets; bounded memory/message rate under adversarial peers; one corrupt location quarantined/refetched correctly; ATP demonstrably faster or more reliable than rsync in target regimes (otherwise no cutover).
STREAM PRIORITY LADDER: critical-control (cancel/lease/authority/fencing/commit) > control (heartbeat/capability/admission) > early usability (.rmeta/dep-info/errors/canonical events) > standard-high (manifests, small start files) > standard (source, ordinary outputs) > bulk-low (toolchain/incremental prefetch) > optional/speculative (prewarm) > repair (retransmission if enabled).
Constituents: Epic J data-plane items (J013, J018-J021) + Epic H seeding.

title: RABS M9: whole-command canonical remote execution over ATP
description:
MILESTONE M9 — port the existing whole-command plane (today's rch exec / hook value) onto canonical + ATP foundations. DELIVERABLES: canonical Cargo-driver execution ON the worker; immutable coherent source/path-dependency snapshot; stable worker execroot + one worker-local jobserver tree; whole-command streaming output, cancellation, bounded final artifact return; ATP object deltas + hot target-state reuse; explicit externally-visible side-effect classification; narrowly admitted CargoWholeCommandBounded cache profile; current-RCH fallback bridge.
ACCEPTANCE: behavior parity with stock/current RCH; no mutable-worktree transfer races (immutable snapshot replaces live rsync of a mutating tree — the mutable-rsync-worktree input model is an explicitly REJECTED alternative: it races live edits, produces vanished-file errors, and cannot give an immutable action identity); whole-command remote builds benefit from object deltas + toolchain/target locality; unclosed target/build-dir side effects disable RESULT caching without disabling remote EXECUTION; no cross-worker second-hop child dispatch (V1: children stay on the selected worker under one worker-local jobserver + process tree; children may still use worker-local/shared CAS and coordinator singleflight); fail-open frontier intact.
RESULT-CACHE BOUNDARY: CargoWholeCommandBounded is result-cacheable only when RABS captures ALL of: immutable command snapshot; exact Cargo/toolchain/config/environment; requested final outputs; the target/build-directory delta needed for subsequent Cargo freshness; build-script metadata/output-cache state; externally visible side effects (or proof none exist). Until proven, whole-command is an EXECUTION plane with hot worker state + deltas, not a universal action cache. Hot worker target state: exclusive TargetStateLease or private clone — never concurrent sharing (I35, R67).

title: RABS M10: workspace rustc action plane
description:
MILESTONE M10 — fine-grained workspace serving: the hardest, highest-value plane (trust-ladder Stage 5). DELIVERABLES: workspace unit/action-family identity produced by canonical Cargo; coherent command snapshot + minimal positive/negative action closure; closed-view enforcement with abort-on-new-read discovery; proc-macro input audit with exact environment; conservative exact dependency-artifact inputs; stable OUT_DIR/incremental/temp/home paths; provisional .rmeta lifecycle + producer-commit obligations; fine-grained remote execution; fleet singleflight + action DAG construction; stock differential verification.
ACCEPTANCE: 10^5-10^6 representative shadow actions with ZERO unexplained divergence before broad serving; cross-worktree hit rate materially exceeds both path-namespaced and full-snapshot-key baselines (validates the I3 minimal-closure design; risk R41 is that a full workspace root in every fine-grained key makes ANY source edit invalidate the entire graph); Cargo pipelining equal or better; producer failure prevents dependent publication and coherently fails/cancels the live build; p95 miss overhead within SLO; no semantic dependency projection enabled without its own shadow gate.
Reachable only after M1 canonical execroot + observed-input closure + long shadow evidence. Constituents: Epic M P0 items.

title: RABS M11: build-script run caching and hermeticity
description:
MILESTONE M11 — BuildScriptRun caching. DELIVERABLES: canonical Cargo-driver interception seam + launcher-shim feasibility matrix (the shim is evidence-gated, NOT assumed: must prove executable identity, mtimes, Cargo fingerprints, output-cache behavior, and inherited jobserver descriptors remain correct across stable/beta/nightly; if a shim perturbs Cargo, use canonical-driver process interposition or leave BuildScriptRun caching disabled); exact stdout/stderr bytes, per-stream ordering, recorded cross-stream event sequence where observed, Cargo directive capture/replay; generated output bundle; explicit environment + filesystem/process/network input closure; strict time/randomness/git/secret classification; registry-aggressive vs workspace-audit-first policy split; deterministic audit + denylist.
ACCEPTANCE: shim/interposition preserves Cargo fingerprints, executable mtimes/identity, jobserver descriptors, output-cache files, and DEP_LINKS_* semantics across supported Cargo versions; target >80% of observed registry build scripts safely cacheable (subject to corpus); zero divergence; failed/cancelled partial outputs never publish; workspace volatile actions accurately explained via rch why.
GUARDRAILS: pre-run OUT_DIR/Cargo output-cache state is part of the key whenever the program can observe it; replay atomically installs the COMPLETE post-state including deletions/tombstones into a clean private dir then swaps — never merges into a stale OUT_DIR (risk R66); path-valued directives (cargo:rustc-link-search) must resolve to declared generated outputs, immutable toolchain/native datasets, or explicitly captured host-bound inputs under the same canonical path for every consumer, else the run is nonportable/volatile (R122); replay validates every directive-referenced path is inside the installed post-run tree BEFORE exposing stdout to Cargo.
Constituents: Epic N items.

title: RABS M12: test-result cache
description:
MILESTONE M12 — first-class test-result caching (compilation alone does not capture agent intent-to-green latency). DELIVERABLES: nextest target-runner/interception feasibility proof; per-test and bounded batch keys; positive/negative data-input + side-effect observation; stable-pass cache for admitted tests; deterministic-failure + flaky classifications; fixture/setup side-effect protection; affected-test advisory model; doctest action classes; periodic fresh full-suite policy.
ACCEPTANCE: repeated agent test loops show substantial latency savings; ZERO incorrect passing hits; side-effecting/flaky/volatile tests never masquerade as stable hits; nextest output/cwd/env/signals/retries/status semantics match across supported versions; periodic full-suite validation detects missing edges and cache masking.
ELIGIBILITY DOCTRINE: a test is result-cacheable only if all data/process/network/time/randomness inputs are closed, it has no unrepresented externally-visible side effects, no fixture generation or shared-state initialization is skipped, its sandbox and runner semantics are reproducible, and project policy permits that lane. Process-per-test isolation does NOT prove semantic independence — suite-order/once-per-suite-init/shared-DB/port/temp coupling forces a TestBinaryBatch/suite action or bypass (R69). The test-binary digest conservatively invalidates every test in that binary; finer code-to-test projections are advisory research, not V1 correctness inputs. Retry-only passes are flaky, never stable passes (R91). A cached pass is an execution-reuse fact, not proof of program correctness; release CI periodically bypasses the cache.
Constituents: Epic O items.

title: RABS M13: incremental time travel (evidence-gated)
description:
MILESTONE M13 — branch-aware incremental-state snapshots (time travel). Until this milestone is authoritative, shared serving runs admitted classes with incremental compilation DISABLED, or treats the complete incremental input/output state as private nonshareable execution state — an incremental directory is NEVER an implicit unkeyed input. DELIVERABLES: stable logical incremental path (/__rabs/incremental/UNIT) + hidden snapshot manifest identity; compatibility contract across toolchain/target/profile/projection/output-platform/isolation class; FastCDC content-defined chunking + zstd (adjacent incremental states are highly self-similar); git/source-state ancestry index; nearest-compatible-ancestor selection; transfer-vs-rebuild ROI model (no transfer when state size exceeds predicted compile saving); branch/worktree prewarm; bounded per-repo lineage retention + reachability/LRU GC; exact output+state atomic bundling.
ACCEPTANCE: branch ping-pong at least 3x faster on target workloads; storage growth bounded and explainable; snapshots portable only across proven canonical/platform classes; no regression when snapshot transfer costs more than rebuild.
KILL CRITERION: if representative corpora show poor latency ROI or unacceptable storage/complexity, retain exact artifact caching and DEFER state serving — this feature is explicitly killable (risk R17/R18).
SAFETY: every restored snapshot is materialized as a per-attempt private writable clone/copy; the retained snapshot and CAS chunks remain immutable and are never mounted writable by two rustc processes; capture occurs only after the producing compiler and its output writers are quiescent; incremental manifest + matching ordinary outputs publish as ONE auxiliary snapshot unit; crash/cancel before commit leaves only disposable staging; a sampled cold/exact rebuild verifies compatibility before a snapshot family gains portable authority (R128).
Constituents: Epic P items.

title: RABS M14: speculation, critical path, CI prewarm
description:
MILESTONE M14 — agent-native acceleration. SAVE-TIME WATCHER pipeline: detect a stable-enough edit boundary (debounce + editor write semantics) -> snapshot changed source immutably -> infer likely action set from historical agent commands + provenance DAG -> select nearest compatible incremental snapshot -> submit low-priority speculative actions -> brown out under pressure -> promote INSTANTLY if the agent invokes the matching command -> measure saved foreground latency and wasted work. GIT-EVENT PREWARM: branch checkout, HEAD change, pull/rebase/merge, worktree creation, lockfile update, toolchain file change, CI push -> fetch/materialize snapshot, locate nearest state, prewarm dependency + workspace critical path, seed likely workers, optionally pre-run canonical test subset, stop immediately under foreground pressure. PROMOTION semantics: same action actor/key/generation; scheduler priority+deadline promoted; already-transferred inputs and partial execution retained; optional-work brownout suspended while foreground interest exists; provenance records the promotion. Plus: provenance-DAG critical-path scheduler (slow dependency blocking many crates outranks an independent leaf); CI canonical writer + trust tier (CI-signed provenance gets stronger trust classification — a publication/access policy, never a content-identity difference); speculation ROI dashboard.
ACCEPTANCE: positive net saved foreground latency after wasted-work accounting; foreground p95 improves; speculation never causes pressure regression under gates (I18: speculation/prewarm/audits brown out before user-requested actions or required cleanup); promoted actions retain work correctly.
FLAGSHIP DEMO: the daemon compiles the agent's diff while the agent is composing its next message, so the subsequent Cargo command is already a hit or joins an in-progress action.
Constituents: Epic Q items Q001-Q010 + I015 critical-path estimator.

title: RABS M15: fragmentation analyzer and rch advise
description:
MILESTONE M15 — turn fleet provenance/timing data into convergence recommendations. FRAGMENTATION ANALYZER identifies avoidable key fragmentation: multiple versions of hot dependencies; feature-unification drift; inconsistent lockfiles; toolchain drift; differing RUSTFLAGS/profiles; target-CPU drift; path drift / noncanonical actions; command-palette drift; build-script volatility; platform fragmentation; semantically-identical duplicate source snapshots. Output quantifies cost (example format: "12.4% of compiler-seconds lost because syn appears in 3 versions; 8.1% because check/test feature sets diverge; 6.7% because two workers use different rustc commits; 4.0% because one profile uses target-cpu=native") and recommends convergence actions. RCH ADVISE recommends codebase changes with evidence, expected saved latency, confidence, and explicit non-claims: split crates dominating rebuild tails; reduce broad feature coupling; move stable APIs behind smaller interface crates; isolate proc macros and build scripts; align dependency versions; reduce generated-code churn; identify link bottlenecks; identify tests dominating repeated loops; suggest profile/linker/toolchain configurations.
ACCEPTANCE: recommendations identify measurable compiler-second savings; advice is attributable and confidence-labeled; NO automatic source/config mutation without explicit operator action.
Constituents: Q011, Q012, R010, R011.

title: RABS M16: evidence-gated frontier
description:
MILESTONE M16 — the explicitly gated frontier list. CANDIDATES: multi-peer object fetch + worker-seeding optimization; RaptorQ repair on measured lossy WAN paths; multipath/fan-out; automatic adaptive transfer-brain tuning; external REAPI gateway (stateless, isolated, may use Tokio/Tonic since it is off the critical internal path — carries NO authority to weaken native cancellation/scheduling/CAS/trust/fencing semantics); custom native-CPU rustc/LLVM build profile (KILL if measured gain <3%); PGO/BOLT experiment; future rustc public_api_hash / relink-dont-rebuild integration; macOS strict VM/chroot serving improvements; cross-worker nested child-action dispatch (needs its own design review + benchmark); standby coordinator automation or — only if eventually required — real replicated coordination with consensus/external fencing, never a monotonic counter in two local databases masquerading as authority.
DISCIPLINE: every frontier item must carry hypothesis, corpus/benchmark, expected value, complexity+risk budget, proceed threshold, KILL criterion, rollback plan, and explicit no-claims. None may preempt or block the core product (I27; risk R30 "advanced ATP work distracts core").
FRONTIER DEFINITION OF DONE: incremental time travel materially improves branch workflows under bounded storage; speculation saves more foreground latency than it costs; critical-path scheduling improves tail latency; fragmentation advice leads to measurable convergence; advanced ATP transfer features outperform simpler paths in identified regimes; REAPI compatibility expands deployment options without contaminating native semantics.

title: RABS Epic A: repository and architecture foundation
description:
EPIC A — Repository and architecture foundation. Establishes the crate/process boundaries, schema registries, and policy scaffolding everything else builds on.
CRATE MAP (each with strict rules): rabs-protocol (stable domain+wire schemas shared by wrappers/edge/coordinator/workers/gateways/harnesses; NO Asupersync dep, NO Tokio dep, no fs/process effects; canonical codecs + schema versions; bounded collections/recursion/payloads; forward/unknown-field policy; golden wire fixtures; N/N-1 compatibility tests). rabs-action (pure action semantics + state machines: lifecycle transitions, subscriber interest accounting, attempt fencing, deterministic retry classification, publication eligibility, provisional metadata ownership, failure taxonomy, result validation, pure reconciliation decisions — runnable in the Asupersync lab AND ordinary deterministic unit/property tests with no network/fs). rabs-key (canonical semantic key construction, discovery recipes, presentation variants, explainability; returns ActionKey + ActionKeyBreakdown + optional PresentationVariantKey). rabs-cas (durable CAS, action-cache indexing, object lifecycle, publication transactions; metadata-store abstraction with reference SQLite backend + gated FrankenSQLite). rabs-sandbox (coherent snapshot capture, canonical execroot construction, kernel isolation, environment policy, input observation, output harvesting). rabs-scheduler (build-action admission/placement — distinct from Asupersync's internal runtime scheduler). rabs-asupersync (the ONLY broad adapter to Asupersync/ATP implementation types; no durable/public schema may contain its types). rabs-edge + rabs-coord (may initially ship combined in one binary rabsd, roles stay explicit). rabs-wkr (specialized trusted worker daemon — NOT a mode of the broad atpd binary). Tiny wrappers: rch-rustc, rch-workspace-rustc, rch-link, rch-cc/rch-cxx/rch-ar, existing rch exec as canonical driver entry, optional nextest adapter after proof. rabs-reapi-gateway (optional, isolated, translation-only, no authority).
ALSO OWNED HERE: schema/version registries (key, protocol, database, object-manifest, sandbox); stable reason-code registry (families KEY_* CACHE_* INPUT_* PATH_* TOOLCHAIN_* PLATFORM_* SANDBOX_* WORKER_* PRESSURE_* TRANSFER_* LEASE_* AUTHORITY_* CANCEL_* DELIVERY_* PUBLICATION_* EVIDENCE_* STORAGE_* VERIFY_* QUARANTINE_* FALLBACK_* PROTOCOL_* SPECULATION_* TEST_* — append-only within a protocol major version); shared redaction library + data-classification policy; dependency-direction CI; Asupersync revision pin + upgrade bot; unsafe-boundary ledger; supply-chain budgets; single-active coordinator authority contract; platform/isolation authority matrix with explicit no-claims; the four-state-machine domain split (BuildOperation / logical action publication / execution attempt / subscriber delivery — I29); canonical-result vs attempt-evidence vs publication-record schema split (I37); byte-preserving Unix path/argv/env wire types (UTF-8 is presentation only — I38/R89); publication-history vs serving-disposition split (I50); RABS-owned causal timestamp/deadline/duration/peer/authority wire types (never leak Asupersync types — I14); requested->resolved snapshot lineage in schemas (I53); binary-specific release profiles (tiny wrappers optimize startup/size with panic containment kept; daemons/workers optimize sustained throughput from opt-level 3 — RCH's current workspace-wide opt-level=z profile is an input to migrate, NOT to copy; R100); LICENSE metadata correction (RCH workspace advertises plain MIT but the license file is the rider-bearing MIT-with-OpenAI/Anthropic-Rider — must become LicenseRef + consistent SBOM before releases; R72).

title: RABS Epic B: record/replay corpus, benchmarks, Layer 0 pack
description:
EPIC B — Record/replay and benchmark corpus (+ Layer 0 pack). The measurement program is a first-class product surface: the corpus is simultaneously benchmark input, shadow-verification input, regression suite, key-stability study, scheduler training/evaluation data, and launch evidence. North-star metric: p50/p90/p95 INTENT-TO-RESULT latency over replayed real agent traces including queueing, source capture, key construction, cache lookup, transfer, compiler/linker execution, test execution, output materialization, Cargo notification, cancellation, retries.
CORPUS DESIGN: capture every relevant tool invocation with normalized args + input hashes (NOT source contents by default); record command/build/session context; retain outcomes, diagnostics digests, output manifests, timing, resource usage, worker/local placement; support replay under stock and RABS paths; anonymize/redact; stratify by repo, action class, agent count, clean/warm state, command type.
BENCHMARK SCENARIOS (required): cold clean build; no-op rebuild; single leaf edit; single high-fanout dependency edit; root/application edit; implementation-only upstream edit; public-interface upstream edit; check->test->clippy alternation; branch ping-pong A<->B; new worktree first command; fifteen-agent compile storm; mixed compile/test storm; worker loss during compile; network partition during output upload; cache corruption/refetch; CI commit prewarm then developer pull; rust-analyzer check loop.
REPORTED METRICS per benchmark: whole-command p50/p90/p95; first-diagnostic + first-metadata-ready latency; compiler/linker/test seconds executed vs saved; served-vs-executed ratio; hit rate + miss taxonomy; queue delay; transfer bytes/dedup/throughput; CPU+memory local/remote; storage growth; speculation cost/value; correctness/divergence.
COMPARATIVE BASELINES: stock Cargo/rustc; Layer-0-only; sccache local + LAN; existing RCH whole-command remote; RABS whole-command plane; RABS fine-grained plane; optional external REAPI/NativeLink benchmark.
PERFORMANCE GATES: a feature may not become default-on if it violates wrapper/miss SLOs, worsens p95 intent-to-result without compensation, blows storage/transfer cost, causes unexplainable hit-rate degradation, reduces cancellation responsiveness/cleanup reliability, or lacks rollback switch + evidence receipt.
Also hosts the M-1 Layer-0 configuration pack tasks (immediate wins that define the baseline).

title: RABS Epic C: tiny wrapper and local daemon protocol
description:
EPIC C — Tiny wrapper and local daemon protocol. The wrapper is deliberately tiny: minimal deps and startup, no full runtime init, no remote connection establishment, no direct shared-CAS or action-index writes, ONE local edge-daemon round trip, byte/line streaming (never whole-output buffering). Rejected alternative: full Asupersync in every wrapper (startup latency, binary weight, nested-runtime hazards, fail-open complexity).
DELIVERY FRONTIER MODEL (the epicenter of fail-open correctness — I11/I43/I46): each subscriber/wrapper has one ordered delivery stream and TWO exposure frontiers. (1) Silent/NoStatefulCommit: nothing exposed -> seamless local nonpublishing fallback may be safe. (2) TranscriptExposed/NoStatefulCommit: diagnostics/stdout/stderr shown -> reconnect or fail coherently by default; optional explicitly-Labeled Transcript Recovery mode may detach and rerun the original chain with an unmistakable boundary marker. (3) StatefulCommitIntentOrCommit (.rmeta notification replayed, output declared ready, cached terminal result exposed) -> NO uncoordinated fallback ever; reconnect/continue or fail coherently. Stateful items use write-ahead intent recording + full-write wrapper acknowledgement + DeliveryUncertain fail-closed on crash between write and ack (R97). Transcript items use ordered framed sequencing WITHOUT fsync-per-diagnostic-line (R104); an in-flight unacknowledged frame is conservatively TranscriptDeliveryUncertain, never pre-exposure (R116). On reconnect the wrapper reports last-fully-exposed sequence + possibly-in-flight frame.
WRAPPER FLOW: validate bounded re-entry depth + signed self-host bypass marker (I36/R70); capture argv, decoded wrapper chain, canonical/real cwd, exact env digest, stdin mode, parent Cargo context; classify action class/outputs/unsupported patterns; connect to edge UDS with tiny bounded timeout + resumable request token; receive ExecuteOriginalChain | ServeHit | JoinAction | RemoteExecute | PolicyRefused; stream events with one monotonic subscriber sequence; materialize each output BEFORE replaying the state-advancing event that declares it ready; return exact tool exit status as the terminal delivered item; forward SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP + parent-death + disconnect into subscriber cancellation, preserving signal-vs-exit classification (re-signal self on signal termination rather than translating to 128+N — R94); PTY/interactive actions are local passthrough.
PANIC CONTAINMENT (I49/R105): panic=unwind, nonprinting pre-exposure panic hook, top-level unwind containment; before exposure an internal panic executes the exact original chain; abort-on-panic prohibited unless a separate minimal parent guard proves the same behavior; allocator abort/OOM mitigated via bounded allocation.
LOCAL PROTOCOL: length-bounded canonical frames; request + ordered subscriber-delivery sequence domain with request ID/resumable token/last-accepted + possibly-in-flight sequence; peer credential + socket ownership/mode checks; bounded reconnect grace; version negotiation; no large source content inline; path/presentation context separate from semantic descriptor; edge response names which fallback class (seamless/labeled/none) is still possible; fixtures across wrapper/edge versions and daemon-death points. Edge boot/incarnation/handoff fencing: exactly one incarnation owns subscriber materialization rights except during bounded named-predecessor handoff (I47 analog for edges; R118).

title: RABS Epic D: canonical execroot and path handling
description:
EPIC D — Canonical execroot and path handling (Invariants I1/I19/I20/I41; the M1 keystone). Semantically visible paths are stable and NEVER contain action keys, attempt IDs, snapshot IDs, worker IDs, or subscriber IDs — those exist only in hidden physical backing paths behind mount namespace/chroot/VM. Layout: /__rabs/workspace (fixed primary root — every sandbox is isolated so a fixed path is safe); /__rabs/repos/LOGICAL-REPO-ID (path-dependency repos with stable logical IDs from Cargo/package source identity or project-configured UUID + closure role — never from mutable git remote URL/checkout path/branch/commit); /__rabs/registry/CHECKSUM and /__rabs/git/CHECKSUM (immutable sources); /__rabs/toolchain (immutable DatasetObject mounted at stable path, NOT digest-bearing); /__rabs/cargo-home; /__rabs/out/UNIT, /__rabs/build/UNIT/out (build-script OUT_DIR), /__rabs/incremental/UNIT; /__rabs/tmp; /__rabs/home; /run/rabs-secrets/SLOT.
CRITICAL RULES: Cargo owns the semantically visible output + OUT_DIR paths — RABS canonicalizes Cargo BEFORE planning and maps Cargo's exact requested paths to hidden backing storage; it never invents a replacement OUT_DIR after Cargo established unit identity. VirtualPath preserves native path-component bytes on Unix (no UTF-8 assumption). Every sandbox declares a FilesystemSemanticClass (case sensitivity, Unicode normalization, symlink/hardlink semantics, exec-bit/permission behavior, xattr/ACL policy); actions that can observe namespace behavior require class equality (R71). Path remapping flags supplement canonical execution, never substitute for it.
BUILD-PATH SEMANTIC POLICY (I41 — canonical paths can change real behavior: file!(), env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR), OUT_DIR-derived strings, panic locations, embedded source maps, runtime resource lookup, path-asserting tests): each workspace action selects one versioned policy: CanonicalPortablePath (project opts in; cross-worktree serving after gates) | PathOpaqueVerified (differential/path-leak evidence proves output profile cannot distinguish) | ProjectRelativeRemapped (validated toolchain profile with stable project-relative semantics) | SubscriberPathPreserving (original paths, keyed semantic identity, no broad portability). Default for a new family is shadow/audit — never assume canonical paths are harmless (R96). Runtime-visible canonical strings are semantic even if never opened; code later opening a build-time path is RuntimePathSensitive (R84).
MTIME/FRESHNESS: outputs become newer than inputs from Cargo's perspective; dep-info consistent with subscriber mapping; repeated hits cause no rebuild storms; atomic rename prevents partial trees; checksum-freshness opt-in absorbed later without changing CAS semantics. MUTABLE STATE OWNERSHIP (I33/I35/I45): private per-worktree targets; exclusive TargetStateLease or clone for whole-command hot state; NO writable hardlinks to CAS inodes (read-only bind/reflink-CoW/copy only); per-operation destination arbiter reserves declared output paths — disjoint bundles install concurrently, overlaps serialize/bypass/fail (R98). PATH LEAK AUDIT: scan artifacts/metadata/events/generated source/dep-info for worktree roots, homes, worker temp/CAS roots, hidden physical paths, hostnames, usernames, real target dirs, secret backing paths, divergent Cargo metadata hashes; classify findings (admitted-canonical / presentation-only / remappable-debug / key-relevant leak / output-semantic path sensitivity / privacy incident / evidence Cargo was not canonical). Cross-worktree tests compare Cargo child argv, -C metadata, output filenames, .rmeta, dep-info, selected binary sections — not just normalized descriptors. Also owns: coherent snapshot capture w/ mutation retry; edge content-identity index (digest memoization with receipts/statx/watch-generation evidence — mtime/size alone never content authority; overflow forces rescan — R83); canonical dep-info + byte-correct subscriber-specific derivation (I39/R85); requested->resolved snapshot lineage (I53/R110).

title: RABS Epic E: sandbox and observed-input discovery
description:
EPIC E — Sandbox and observed-input discovery (hermetic by construction, observation second). DEFAULTS: network denied; clock strict-virtual/fixed only in profiles that can enforce it (vDSO can bypass syscall tracing — R46), else volatile evidence; TZ=UTC; fixed UTF-8 locale; canonical hostname/user/home; randomness denied or declared deterministic seed; git metadata hidden unless an explicit git-state object; environment = exact scrubbed allowlist wholly hashed as presented (NEVER inferred from getenv tracing — I21/R45); filesystem = immutable declared/observed closure + controlled outputs/temp, fixed umask + filesystem semantic class; process context = closed inherited-FD set, canonical argv0/cwd, bounded rlimits, declared CPU-count/topology view (R78); secrets capability-mounted at stable slots; external services denied unless split into captured fetch actions.
COHERENT SNAPSHOT CAPTURE: resolve workspace/lockfile/.cargo config/toolchain files/path-dep closure; include policy-relevant untracked files + symlinks; exclude ephemeral locks + build outputs; prefer fs snapshot/reflink primitives, else directory-generation watcher + two stable scans with per-file open-descriptor hash + before/after identity verification; RETRY entire capture on any mutation during the window (I2/R52); refuse authoritative snapshotting where a coherent boundary is impossible; never silently substitute fake time/randomness/git/host identity for projects that intentionally consume the real value (that normalization is an explicit keyed sandbox policy or the action loses shared authority).
SOURCE-CAPTURE CONFIDENTIALITY (I38/R82): SourceCapturePolicy path classes BuildInputAllowed/LocalOnly/SecretCapability/Denied/ExplicitOperatorApproval; .gitignore is NEVER a security boundary; credential/key/.env paths default denied or secret-capability; symlink/bind escapes, device files, sockets, unrelated home/ancestor paths refused; every out-of-closure read must belong to a declared immutable toolchain/SDK/native dataset or an explicit ExternalInputCapability (stable virtual mount + object identity + privacy scope + revocation/version — R129); undeclared external reads make the action local-only/volatile, never opportunistically uploaded; denied-path observations stay in an edge-private receipt.
OBSERVATION LAYERS (combined because none is complete): rustc dep-info; binary-dep dep-info; successful AND failed opens; directory enumeration/globs; symlink resolution/path escapes; subprocess execution + executable selection (PATH misses are negative deps); network attempts; Cargo rerun directives; output write-set; declared git/time/randomness capability use; metadata-only queries (stat/lstat/access/mtime reads); loader/plugin activity, inherited FDs, argv0, cwd/realpath, umask/rlimits, CPU count/affinity, system identity probes. ABSENCE CAPTURE IS MANDATORY: missing paths/dir contents/exec-lookup alternatives -> NegativeDependencySet (a new file satisfying a previously failed open MUST invalidate — R57); absent env vars -> PresentedEnvironment only (no duplication — F027). Raw readdir order/metadata observability restricts to proven materializer/filesystem class or nonportable (R93). Unbounded namespace observation is promoted to a declared snapshot input, narrowed by config, or classified volatile — never serialized into enormous keys.
DISCOVERY CYCLE: ActionFamilyKey (stable unit+invocation shape WITHOUT source content — else every edit orphans the recipe) -> coordinator DiscoveryActor singleflight -> discovery run against conservative broad read-only snapshot capturing everything -> closed-view re-execution + comparison before FIRST authoritative publication (except classes with known-complete pre-enforced closures — E024) -> authoritative runs expose ONLY the closed view + approved capabilities and ABORT + re-discover on any new read (I3/E021) -> sampled re-audit. Recipes are optimization hints, never trust anchors. Effect classes: Hermetic / HermeticWithCapabilities / ObservedStable / PathSensitive / HostIdentitySensitive / ClockSensitive / RandomnessSensitive / GitStateSensitive / NetworkSensitive / SecretSensitive / SideEffecting / Nondeterministic / Unclosable. Isolation profiles: StrictHermeticLinux (fleet-share eligible) / StrictHermeticVm / HostSandboxAudit (shadow/dev-local) / DependencyImmutableFastPath / VolatileLocal. Descendant containment beyond process groups: cgroup/PID-namespace or VM (a child can setsid out of a process group — R90). Cargo fetch/resolution is an explicit captured phase; workspace mutations (Cargo.lock) go through a private overlay + preconditioned replay (R76/R77).

title: RABS Epic F: action keys and explainability
description:
EPIC F — Action keys and explainability (Invariant G2: soundness AND stability, never a tradeoff). ActionKey = domain-separated SHA-256 over length-delimited canonical bytes of: key_epoch, projection_epoch, action_class, normalized_invocation, virtual_working_directory (single authoritative field — R107), action_input_manifest (positive inputs only), negative_dependency_set, dependency_artifact_inputs, presented_environment, toolchain_contract, output_platform_contract, sandbox_semantic_policy, build_path_semantic_policy, execution_semantics, logical_output_declarations. V1 digest: SHA-256 with typed algorithm+domain IDs ("rabs.action-key.sha256.v1" framing); raw 32-byte values from different domains NEVER interchangeable (R121); BLAKE3 only for local prechecks. EXCLUDED from keys: queue priority, worker identity, kernel version, subscriber kind, attempt purpose, cgroup size, transfer plan, presentation rendering.
EPOCHS: key_epoch = cheap global invalidation on key-logic change; projection_epoch = versioned dependency/input projections; an epoch bump creates a COLD namespace, never reinterprets old entries.
NORMALIZED INVOCATION: fully decoded wrapper chain + actual compiler identity; args with meaningful order preserved; response files by content + semantic position (not unstable filenames); --extern resolved to conservative artifact identities; crate type/edition/target/profile/features/cfgs/lints/codegen/emit; link args + native lib identities; canonical byte strings on Unix. Excludes: socket paths, request/subscriber/attempt/worker IDs, real worktree/staging roots, local target spelling, jobserver descriptors, color/width.
DEPENDENCY IDENTITY (I22): default = exact content identity of the artifact actually supplied (rmeta if rmeta passed, whole rlib if rlib, proc-macro dylib + runtime deps, ordered link inputs, all LTO bitcode consumed). Reduced projections require: invocation-class proof rustc cannot observe omitted bytes + versioned extractor + zero-divergence shadow corpus + auto-disable on ambiguous flags/toolchain change (R49). Early cutoff then emerges automatically from byte-equal .rmeta — RABS builds no source-level API parser.
ENVIRONMENT: categories SemanticConstant/SemanticHashed/SemanticNormalized/ScrubbedAbsent/SecretOpaqueDigest/VolatileRefusal/PresentationOnly; RUSTFLAGS+CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS semantic; PATH = canonical ordered tool manifest with lookup failures as key inputs; jobserver descriptors excluded and replaced per host; output-affecting secrets contribute trusted opaque HMAC(value/version/scope) or force noncacheable (capability ID alone insufficient — R56); raw secrets never in breakdowns/receipts/logs.
CONTRACTS: ToolchainContract (compiler digest + commit, LLVM identity, sysroot root, Cargo identity for canonical actions, rustdoc/clippy, linker/native tools, target spec digest, unstable-feature profile, RABS semantic-adapter epoch). OutputPlatformContract (keyed): target triple/ABI, host ABI for proc-macros/build scripts, explicit CPU baseline (-C target-cpu=native NEVER silently normalized — explicit host cohort or refused), libc/linker/SDK/deployment target, filesystem semantic class by default. ExecutionEligibility (NOT keyed): kernel caps, RAM/disk, pressure, worker identity, sandbox implementation choice, locality (I23).
EXPLAINABILITY: every key returns ActionKeyBreakdown (structured redaction-safe component tree); key diff powers rch why miss with stable taxonomy (source changed / dep metadata changed / dep impl changed under LTO / flags-profile-features / environment / toolchain / platform / observed input set / sandbox policy / first seen / quarantined-expired-evicted / trust refused / materialization unavailable). Property tests: irrelevant path/agent changes preserve key; mutation tests: EVERY semantic input changes key. Presentation (I24): canonical structured compiler event log; PresentationContract for color/width/path rendering; PresentationVariantKey only for exact byte-transcript replay; uncertain rendering fidelity bypasses rather than pollutes. Also owns: ActionFamilyKey + DiscoveryActor identity (repo-scoped — F026); structured CoordinatorAuthority/ActionGeneration (never-reused opaque generation IDs + ABA tombstones — I51/R108)/AttemptAuthority/ExecutionLease identity model; descriptor object byte-verification on every hit (F024); role-tagged single logical-output map (R125/F035).

title: RABS Epic G: Asupersync runtime, regions, process lifecycle
description:
EPIC G — Asupersync runtime, regions, and process lifecycle. ADOPT-NOW capabilities: Cx/regions/task ownership (daemon, build-intent, action, attempt, worker-session, transfer ownership); Budget/deadlines/checkpoints; four-valued Outcome (Ok/Err/Cancelled/Panicked — RABS additionally distinguishes DeterministicFailure/VolatileFailure/InfrastructureFailure/WorkerLost/LeaseExpired/Cancelled/OomKilled/SignalTerminated/InternalPanic/PolicyRefused; only classified deterministic failures are publication-eligible); structured spawn/join/race with drained losers; channels+obligations; process subsystem (groups, cancel-drain, escalation, reaping); supervision; remote named computations; RemoteCap/leases/idempotency; ATP objects/manifests/journals/sparse writers; deterministic lab; observability; RCH health policy; SLO brownout bridge; pool sizing (advisory).
REGION TREES (must be reflected in tracing/crashpacks so every leaked effect attributes to region/authority/operation/generation/action/attempt): Edge: RabsEdgeRoot { LocalApiRegion{WrapperConnectionRegion...}, CoordinatorSessionRegion, CargoDriverRegion(command){CargoRootPermitRegion, CoherentSnapshotRegion, PathTranslationRegion, SubscriberRegion(id), LocalMaterializationOrFallbackRegion}, EdgeObjectCacheRegion, EdgeObservabilityRegion }. Coordinator: RabsCoordinatorRoot(authority) { EdgeSessionRegion..., WorkerFleetRegion{WorkerSessionRegion, HealthCollector}, BuildOperationRegistryRegion, DiscoveryRegistryRegion, ActionRegistryRegion{ActionRegion(key){SubscriberSet, CacheLookup, AttemptSet{AttemptProxy...}, OutputVerification, Publication}}, SchedulerAndRootPermitRegion, SpeculationRegion, GarbageCollectionRegion, ReconciliationRegion, ObservabilityRegion }. Worker attempt: WorkerActionAttemptRegion(key, generation, attempt, lease, boot-gen) { ObjectFetch, SandboxMaterialization, InputEnforcementAndTrace, CompilerProcessRegion{StdoutDrain, StderrDrain, DescendantProcessGroup}, EarlyMetadata, OutputHarvest, OutputUpload, PreparedResultOffer, CleanupFinalizer }.
OBLIGATION CATALOG (explicit domain types; producing attempt offers a candidate only after attempt-local success obligations resolve; publication additionally requires canonical-result/object-closure/authority/provisional-lineage obligations; cancelled/failed paths still resolve cleanup before region close; Cargo root permits held for full process lifetime, released exactly once): CoordinatorAuthority, CargoRootPermit, WorkerAssignment, ActionGeneration, ExecutionLease, AttemptFence, CoherentSnapshot, ActionInputClosure, SourceSnapshotPin, InputObjectPin, OutputStagingPin, ProvisionalMetadata, DirectProducerCommit, TransitiveProvisionalLineage, DiagnosticStream, ProcessGroupDrain, PreparedResultOffer, CoordinatorPublication, SubscriberDelivery, SubscriberNotification, PerSubscriberObservableCommit, TargetStateLease, WinnerCommit, SandboxCleanup, JournalCheckpoint.
PROCESS MANAGEMENT: spawn under attempt ownership; concurrent stdout/stderr capture with byte bounds + spill-to-object; replace local jobserver handles; register descendants; cancellation checkpoints at pre-spawn/post-spawn/IO/wait; graceful TERM -> drain -> bounded escalation -> reap all; classify actual termination cause; release slots/tokens only after ownership resolved; cancellation progress receipt. Unix process group is NOT a complete descendant boundary (setsid escape) — StrictHermeticLinux uses action cgroup + PID namespace as ultimate containment; VM profiles use the VM boundary. Retire RCH ad hoc remote PGID-file/SSH-kill once parity proven.
SUPERVISION: wrapper connection=stop; worker session=restart w/ bounded backoff + reconcile before new authoritative work; ATP endpoint=restart/escalate; action actor=stop or controlled retry (new fenced attempts, never actor-replacement ambiguity); health collector=restart (stale evidence fails closed for remote-required); CAS writer=escalate on invariant violation; compat HTTP/OTel island=restart/stop isolated; GC=restart w/ cadence; speculation=stop/restart optional. COMPAT ISLAND POLICY: no new Tokio in rabs-action/key/cas or native action path without approved exception; islands have bounded queues + cancellation adapters, no publication authority, may fail without preventing local execution, each has exit criterion. Runtime profile: minimal audited rabs-profile features; no browser/Kafka/DB/H3/WebTransport/mailbox/relay unless needed; io_uring only after measured benefit; CI emits dependency/feature-graph artifact. Nested-runtime prohibition + regression pins (no nested block_on).

title: RABS Epic H: durable CAS and metadata
description:
EPIC H — Durable CAS and metadata (Part XI). OBJECT MODEL: ATP concepts profiled for builds — FileObject (source/rmeta/rlib/object/executable/diagnostic blob), DirectoryObject, SnapshotObject (source/execroot), DatasetObject (toolchain/sysroot/registry set/SDK), ArtifactBundle (complete result output set), SparseImage (incremental state), StreamObject (event archives), ApplicationDefinedObject (results/provenance/receipts/failure bundles). Timestamps excluded from logical identity ONLY for profiles proving them nonsemantic; permissions/symlinks/exec bits/xattrs follow explicit profiles.
DIGESTS: DigestSet{atp_content_id, blake3?, raw_sha256?, logical_size}; ATP domain-separated SHA-256 = native object/manifest identity; V1 authoritative action/schema/authority digests = SHA-256 over length-delimited canonical bytes with fixed domain separators; every serialized digest names algorithm + semantic domain (R121). LOGICAL vs STORED representation split (R81): StoredRepresentationId{logical_object_id, storage_profile_id, encoded_digest, encoded_size}; raw/zstd/packed encodings coexist without path ambiguity; representation selection never changes action keys.
put_if_absent: stream to private temp; enforce logical-size + decompression limits; compute/verify logical digest; optional encode as second private representation; fsync per durability policy; atomic rename + dir fsync; publish under (logical, profile, encoded); concurrent writers race via atomic create/rename with verification; existing-digest/different-bytes = digest-domain collision incident -> quarantine all implicated locations + refuse (never pick one); no partial path ever published.
LAYOUT: cas/{logical/aa/bb/*.meta, representations|chunks|packs/PROFILE/aa/bb/DIGEST, manifests/aa/bb/DIGEST, staging/OP/ATTEMPT/, journals/OP/, quarantine/location|logical/..., temp/, locks/}, metadata/rabs.sqlite. Staging and final CAS on the same filesystem where atomic rename is required; reflinks an optimization never assumed. MANIFEST VALIDATION: reject absolute paths, dotdot, NULs, duplicate/case-colliding paths, escaping symlinks, undeclared hardlinks, device/socket/FIFO nodes, overlapping/out-of-bounds pack ranges; manifests acyclic + depth/fan-out/count bounded (R75/R95); CAS files immutable, never writable-hardlinked (I33/R65).
METADATA STORE (RabsMetadataStore): narrow transactional interface — authority acquisition; action lookup + coordinator-only commit; generation/attempt/lease lifecycle; object location/pin metadata; recipes + key breakdowns; trust/verification/quarantine; GC snapshots; reconciliation scans. Reference SQLite backend = differential/crash truth; FrankenSQLite = gated dogfood (R59). Logical tables: coordinator_authorities, peer_authority_high_water, worker/edge_incarnation_fences, action_entries, action_generations(+tombstones), action_attempts, action_publications, action_serving_states, action_evidence_index, action_trust_evaluations, operations, edge_subscribers, objects, object_locations, object_edges, manifests, pins, leases, location/logical/action_quarantine, worker_sessions/capabilities/health_samples, decision_receipts, provenance_edges, observed_input_recipes, key_breakdowns, determinism_audits, verification_samples, materialization_records, gc_runs, schema_epochs. Constraints: ActionKey unique in active slot; only active authority creates generations/accepts results/commits; generation IDs never reused within cluster lineage (tombstones survive eviction/compaction through the stale-lease window); publication row stores canonical descriptor digest + winner + reachability pin CREATED IN THE SAME TRANSACTION (I8/R111); divergent same-key candidates -> conflict quarantine (semantic vs observable-only vs evidence-only taxonomy — I34/I48/R103); startup reconciliation fails closed on incomplete authority/publication/fence state (R119).
PINS/LEASES: classes ActionPublicationPin/ActiveAttemptInput|OutputPin/ProvisionalMetadataPin/MaterializationPin/TransferPin/VerificationPin/ToolchainInventoryPin/RetentionPolicyPin/AdministrativePin; expiry NEVER by comparing unsynchronized wall clocks — coordinator-issued lease IDs + monotonic renewal sequences + conservative validity; unresolved pins fail toward retention (R127); workers may release candidate pins but never publication roots. GC: reachability-based; mark -> tombstone -> grace -> recheck -> unlink; protects active builds/materializations/transfers/open readers/valid pins; consistent metadata snapshot; planned+actual reclaim receipts; disk-pressure emergency mode never blindly deletes authoritative evidence; correct under concurrent put_if_absent/materialization/seeding (R26/R58). QUARANTINE SCOPES (I15): location (bad copy at one disk/peer -> deselect, refetch elsewhere, keep logical valid) < logical object/manifest (all copies bad -> dependents unavailable until rebuilt) < action entry (semantic divergence/invalid provenance). No silent rewrite under the same digest; release requires verified repair receipt. PUBLICATION PROTOCOL: worker harvests private write set -> validates vs declarations -> uploads under candidate pins -> builds CanonicalActionResultManifest (result identity ONLY) + separate AttemptEvidenceBundle (authority, snapshot, observed inputs, lineage, isolation evidence, raw process/event evidence, timings, verification, incremental ref) -> OfferPreparedActionResult; coordinator verifies authority/generation/lease fences -> byte-compares descriptor -> independently recomputes semantic_result_digest + observable_result_digest from versioned projections -> compare-and-set commit writing pointer + descriptor digest + winner + provenance + publication pin atomically -> ActionResultCommitted emitted only after durable transaction; same-canonical-result recommit is idempotent evidence append; semantic divergence quarantines; observable-only divergence gets presentation quarantine; equal-digests-different-manifest-bytes = serializer/projection-completeness incident (R103). Peer seeding: coordinator-directed, verified on receipt, browns out under pressure, respects namespace ACLs. Deterministic-failure publication: same immutable path with ResultKind::DeterministicFailure; short revalidation TTL in mutable serving state; success-after-failure under identical key = soundness incident, never replacement.

title: RABS Epic I: scheduler and jobserver
description:
EPIC I — Scheduler and jobserver (Part XII). TWO SCHEDULERS: Asupersync runtime scheduling (futures/IO/timers) vs RABS action scheduling (admitting expensive Cargo/compiler/linker/test processes fleet-wide). rabs-coord is the sole authoritative action scheduler in V1; edges may only fail open pre-frontier, never independently lease workers.
ROOT PERMITS + JOBSERVER (I48-risk core): a shared jobserver pipe alone is insufficient because EVERY independent Cargo process assumes one implicit token (R48). Before spawning any managed Cargo process the edge obtains a CargoRootPermit from the coordinator (or coordinator-issued local grant), held until Cargo + descendants + cleanup release it exactly once. A Cargo grant of capacity C = 1 implicit token + at most C-1 transferable jobserver tokens (a grant of 1 exposes ZERO extra tokens — I021). Local descriptors stripped from remote requests; worker-local jobservers never reference client pipes (R7). Grants are PLANE-SPECIFIC (R102): local-Cargo-with-remote-children = graph/frontier grant (CPU admitted separately on workers); whole-command-on-worker = root permit + jobserver derived from that worker's execution grant; coordinated local = edge grant reflecting local pressure; uncoordinated fail-open = NO stale fleet grant reused. ACQUISITION ORDER (fixed, tested, acyclic — R73-adjacent): coordinator graph/root or action admission -> placement + bounded input-transfer reservation -> input materialization + temp/output disk reservation -> worker/edge execution admission + memory envelope -> local jobserver token IMMEDIATELY before spawn -> execution against pre-reserved output capacity. Never hold a compiler token while waiting on bulk transfer (I024); reserve producer/progress capacity per Cargo root; bound provisional-lineage waiters (R112).
RESOURCE MODEL: envelope {cpu_threads, memory_bytes+peak_class, disk r/w, temp, network in/out, linker/lto heaviness, process_count, expected_duration, uncertainty} from historical class/toolchain/crate observations. ADMISSION CLASSES: TinyMetadata, OrdinaryRustc, HeavyCodegen, ProcMacroHost, BuildScriptLight, NativeCompile, HeavyNativeBuild, LinkOrdinary, LinkHeavy, ThinLto, FatLto, TestShort, TestLong, ToolchainTransfer, IncrementalSnapshotTransfer, VerificationAudit, Speculative — each with default concurrency, memory headroom, queue policy, remote break-even threshold.
WORKER SNAPSHOT (scheduler evidence, never key input): identity/generation/incarnation, admin intent, eligibility, queue depth, CPU/load, memory+IO PSI, disk space, toolchain inventory, cache locality, retrieval reliability, cancellation debt, path quality, snapshot age/confidence, canary/quarantine state. HARD EXCLUSIONS before scoring: platform/toolchain mismatch, stale/contradictory health, insufficient headroom, drained/disabled, active-project exclusion, unreliable retrieval, sandbox capability mismatch, trust/identity mismatch, break-even failure under remote-required. SCORE: expected_completion = queue delay + missing-input transfer + toolchain materialization + execution + output return + reliability risk + pressure penalty. BREAK-EVEN: tiny actions with cold remote inputs run locally; long/widely-shared actions justify moderate transfer cost. CRITICAL PATH: prioritize by blocked dependents, historical fan-out, remaining path duration, foreground urgency, metadata-ready potential, uncertainty, prewarm status. HEDGING: only when critical-path + high tail risk + acceptable duplicate cost + independent workers + safe to duplicate + publication fencing active; hedges share the generation, own independent leases (I31). SPECULATION: optional SLO class with brownout ladder. FAIRNESS: weighted fair scheduling over foreground/optional, agent, repo, CI/interactive, long/short, cleanup — with deadline/critical-path overrides and starvation limits; cleanup + cancellation control always retain reserved capacity. POOL SIZING advisory-first; managed resizing needs stable windows, hysteresis, replay validation, operator opt-in, rollback. COORDINATOR CAPACITY is a release gate: shard registries by ActionKey, bounded mailboxes, isolated critical queues, minimal serialized transactions; measure lookup/join/admission/publication latency, mailbox depth, commit latency, loop lag, recovery scan under 15-agent storm + burst (R130).

title: RABS Epic J: ATP protocol and native transport
description:
EPIC J — RABS application protocol over ATP and native transport (Part X). LAYERS: local UDS wrapper protocol -> rabs-edge -> authenticated RABS/ATP coordinator session -> rabs-coord -> authenticated RABS/ATP worker session -> rabs-wkr; native links = UDP/TCP/Tailscale -> QUIC/TLS -> ATP/0 transport -> RABS/1 envelope -> typed messages. Local wrapper, ATP transport, and RABS application versions are DISTINCT and independently negotiated (never "ATP/0+").
HANDSHAKE establishes: transport auth; durable peer identity + key generation; identity-to-cert binding; role; supported ATP versions -> ATP/0; supported RABS versions -> RABS/1; current CoordinatorAuthority; platform classes + eligibility; sandbox/observation profiles; object-store capabilities + digest algorithms + packs/compression/chunking; frame/message/manifest/stream limits; computation-registry versions; restart generation + fresh process-incarnation ID (one active incarnation per identity/generation; edge overlap only via explicit handoff token — I47/R118); causal trace mode + per-domain sequence rules; path class; trust scope. Mismatch -> explicit downgrade/compat route/local fallback/refusal, never silent assumption. Edges/workers dial OUT to the static coordinator by default. QUIC 0-RTT disabled for state-changing messages (R60).
STREAMS: critical-control (cancel, lease renewal, authority, fencing, commit notification) / control / action-events / early-artifacts (.rmeta, dep-info, small metadata) / bulk-objects / telemetry / reconciliation — logical priorities + independent flow-control windows + reserved critical capacity; V1 uses a small dedicated control connection OR proves via loss/throughput/soak that the QUIC scheduler keeps cancellation+lease p99 in budget under bulk saturation (R68). SEQUENCE DOMAINS (I52/R109): AuthorityControl, ActionLifecycle(attempt), SubscriberDelivery(subscriber), ObjectTransfer(transfer), TelemetryBestEffort — each with independent monotonic sequence + ack high-water + bounded replay windows; cross-domain deps are explicit object IDs/authority tuples/causal refs; a missing bulk range never blocks cancellation; duplicates idempotent; terminal/authority sequences persisted before ack; never infer commit from stream closure.
MESSAGE CATALOG: session (RabsClientHello/EdgeHello/WorkerHello/VersionSelected/Capabilities/Ack/SessionRefused/SessionResume/CoordinatorAuthorityAnnounce/PeerAuthorityHighWaterReport/OperatorResetProof/EdgeHandoffOffer|Accepted|Completed/EdgeIncarnationFenced); worker health (Heartbeat/PressureSnapshot/CacheInventoryHint/ToolchainInventory/AdmissionCaveat/DrainState/CargoRootPermitRequest|Granted|Released); object (FindMissingObjectsRequest|Response/ObjectManifestOffer/PackOffer/RangeRequest/RangeData/RangeAckBitmap/CreditUpdate/TransferComplete/VerificationFailed/PinRequest/PinReleased — batched, bounded, range/bitmap ACKs, credit windows, deterministic packs for tiny objects); action (SubmitAction/JoinAction/ActionAccepted/CacheHit/CacheMiss/Queued/Rejected/SubscriberCancelInterest/SubscriberPromotePriority); attempt (LeaseOffer/LeaseAccepted/LeaseRefused/Started/Progress/LeaseRenewal/LeaseExpired/Cancel/DrainProgress/Drained); diagnostics+provisional (CanonicalCompilerEvent/StdoutChunk/StderrChunk/ProvisionalObjectAvailable/MetadataReady/ProvisionalObjectInvalidated/SubscriberTranscriptIntent|Acknowledged|DeliveryUncertain/SubscriberStatefulCommitIntent|Acknowledged|DeliveryUncertain/SubscriberDeliveryComplete — distinct intent/ack/uncertainty/completion messages, R124); publication (OfferPreparedActionResult/PreparedResultAccepted|Rejected/ActionResultCommitted/ActionResultQuarantined/ActionTerminalFailure — there is NO worker-authoritative CommitActionResult); reconciliation (ReconcileOperation/OperationInventory/OperationStateDigest/ResumeAttempt/SupersedeAttempt/RecoverTransferJournal/ReleaseOrphanPins/ReconcileSubscriberDeliveryState); admin (RunDeterminismAudit/RunShadowVerification/CollectFailureBundle/Quarantine*/RepairObject/SeedPeerObjects).
ENVELOPE: versions, session, roles, CoordinatorAuthority for authority ops, causal trace, peer IDs, operation/subscriber or generation/attempt/lease/boot/incarnation identity, idempotency key, sequence domain + per-domain sequence, size/count/nesting limits, capability scope, redaction class. Decoders enforce byte/count/recursion/fanout/decompression limits BEFORE allocation; unknown authority-bearing fields fail closed. CANONICAL SERIALIZATION: deterministic field/map ordering; canonical ints/enums/optionals/bytes; byte-preserving Unix paths/argv/env; bounded everything; duplicate-field rejection; golden fixtures per family; differential encoder tests; ATP extension maps in numeric key order; wire format is NOT Rust repr/serde-bincode incidental layout. IDEMPOTENCY: repeated SubmitAction joins existing actor; repeated lease acceptance returns existing state; repeated range writes digest/range-idempotent; repeated offers return prior decision; repeated cancel/release cannot double-release; stale authority fails closed; leases use coordinator TTLs + monotonic local timers + renewal sequences, never wall-clock comparison (R73). RECONNECT: both sides retain durable state; exchange bounded inventories + per-domain high-waters; pure reconciliation decides resume/supersede/cancel/collect/fail/abandon; publication eligibility reissued only under current authority; orphan pins/processes/permits cleaned after proof; pre-frontier edges may fall back locally (nonpublishing), post-transcript reconnect-or-coherent-failure, post-stateful-intent never uncoordinated. PATHS: LAN -> Tailscale direct -> DERP-assisted -> TCP/TLS-443 fallback if proven -> SSH break-glass; object sources selected independently from execution placement; remote managed QUIC hardening: reactor wakeups (no fixed 1ms poll), injected time, adaptive batching, soak vs established QUIC stacks. Remote computation registry (closed, versioned): rabs.worker.probe/materialize_snapshot/execute_action/query_attempt/cancel_attempt/seed_objects/verify_objects/collect_failure_bundle .v1 — each with opcode, schema versions, max inline bytes, capabilities, idempotency, retry safety, cancellation contract, lease behavior, observability policy, lab fixtures; no large payloads inline. Capability model: ReadObject/WriteStaging/ExecuteAction/OfferPreparedActionResult/MaterializeSnapshot/OpenNetwork/ReadSecret/EmitDiagnostics/SeedPeerObjects/RunVerification/AdminRepair — least-privilege, lease-bounded, redaction-safe, checked by both coordinator policy and worker handlers.

title: RABS Epic K: Cargo/rustc dependency serving
description:
EPIC K — Cargo/rustc dependency serving (Part XIII integration surfaces + M4 product). INTEGRATION SURFACES: rch exec / hook / equivalent launcher starting Cargo inside the canonical driver namespace; RUSTC_WRAPPER (broad interception); RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER (workspace classification); linker proxy; CC/CXX/AR wrappers; gated nextest target-runner; watchers/git hooks for speculation. WRAPPER ROLE SPLIT: outer/global wrapper optimized for registry/git deps (very fast key/lookup, immutable-source assumptions validated by checksum, high hit-rate, conservative exact artifact inputs, minimal intelligence); workspace wrapper adds classification + canonical Cargo context (coherent snapshots, action closures, branch-aware state, speculation, richer provenance). Cargo may nest: $RUSTC_WRAPPER $RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER $RUSTC args — outer wrapper receives the workspace wrapper as its compiler argument for workspace crates and must preserve/normalize the chain; tests cover 1 wrapper, 2 nested, paths with spaces, response files, env overrides, first-enable fingerprint changes.
CANONICAL CARGO DRIVER requirement: before launch resolve EffectiveCargoConfigContract — every applicable workspace/ancestor .cargo/config*, CARGO_HOME config, --config CLI, env override, alias, source replacement, registry, target runner/linker, credential-helper reference, toolchain-selection input — preserving each value's ORIGIN and resolving origin-relative paths exactly as Cargo would ([env] relative semantics, local source replacements); secrets stay capabilities; host-global config never influences an authoritative action invisibly (K015/K019). DEPENDENCY RESOLUTION/FETCH: explicit fetch/resolution phase under bounded network capability producing immutable source/index/config objects; RABS never silently adds --locked/--offline; workspace-file mutations (Cargo.lock) run against a private writable overlay + source-mutation receipt + content-preconditioned replay back to the worktree, aborting on concurrent-edit conflict (R76/R77); immutable fast paths require exact resolved package/source/checksum identity, not name+version.
COMMAND ELIGIBILITY MATRIX (V1): capability probes (-vV/--print) = direct local pass-through or tiny probe cache (no remote tax — R23/K018); build/check/clippy/doc/compile-phase-of-test-bench = canonical driver + admitted acceleration; test/nextest execution = admitted test-action or bounded whole-command; run = compile accelerates, execution local, not result-cached; bench execution = matching-hardware observation, timing NEVER cached (R92); clean/fix/install/publish/package/source-mutating = local or explicit side-effecting whole-command, no result cache; watch/background/interactive/PTY = local passthrough; custom unstable modes (build-std, custom runners, artifact deps) = compatibility-matrix admission or explained bypass. Aliases classified after Cargo/config expansion.
PIPELINING (I12 — verified against Cargo source): Cargo marks its internal metadata dependency edge complete when it parses a rustc artifact-notification JSON line whose path ends in .rmeta — this is NOT Cargo's outward compiler-artifact message (K013). Cache hit: resolve exact .rmeta output + Cargo-requested path -> fetch/verify/materialize atomically -> apply mtime/freshness -> replay the exact rustc artifact-notification line -> Cargo starts dependents -> continue materializing remaining outputs, replaying each required event only after its output is ready -> return after complete materialization. rust-analyzer flows through the same wrappers/cache; shared workspace authority requires rust-analyzer's Cargo to enter the canonical driver, else only the dependency/local lane (K017). Diagnostics fidelity: preserve line-delimited framing/order, stream promptly, store canonical structured events, let Cargo generate its own outward messages, translate virtual paths via tested subscriber mapping, preserve codes/lints/rendered children/exit status, golden fixtures across stable/beta/nightly.

title: RABS Epic L: link and native build acceleration
description:
EPIC L — Link and native build acceleration. EXACT LINK CACHING is in scope; a bespoke incremental linker is NOT (cut; Wild preferred, lld fallback). Link key: linker identity; exact normalized args; ORDERED object/archive/shared-library content identities; linker scripts + response files (by content); environment; target/platform contract; relevant sysroot/runtime objects; output class/flags. The invocation family is discovered then executed under a CLOSED linker filesystem view recording: actual files selected by -l/framework/default search; startup objects; default linker scripts; linker plugins; response-file inclusions; failed/alternative lookup candidates (negative deps). A bare -lfoo is never keyed by spelling alone (R123); an unclosable system search path keeps the link local/nonshareable. Link outputs + diagnostics cache atomically.
NATIVE SUBCOMPILES: inject wrapper identities via CC/CXX/AR + tool-specific launcher settings; native action keys include compiler/archiver identity, normalized flags, source/header closure, generated include roots, target ABI, environment + sandbox policy, declared output, PLUS assembler/linker/subprocess identities, dynamic-loader deps, built-in include roots, pkg-config/SDK resolution, filesystem semantic class. Native outputs become dependencies of the parent build-script action result (provenance edges). CMake/meson launcher integration only where it preserves correctness (P1). This plane precedes the generalized build-script-run cache because it captures a large fraction of expensive dependency build time with mature semantics. Signing/notarization/credentialed post-processing are SEPARATE actions from deterministic link (S016/R74).

title: RABS Epic M: workspace action serving and pipelining
description:
